content.text:
Changing `nameOfDay`'s signature could break 13 files. I haven't changed anything.

I used the graphify query for the call graph. I then confirmed each caller with `rg`.

**Direct callers (5)**
- `packages/lib/availability.ts`: `availabilityAsString` calls `nameOfDay(locale, day, "short")`.
- `packages/lib/weekday.test.ts`: the unit test for `nameOfDay`.
- `apps/web/modules/users/components/UserForm.tsx`
- `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimesHeader.tsx`
- `apps/web/modules/settings/my-account/general-view.tsx`

**Callers of those callers (8)**
- Callers of `availabilityAsString`:
  - `packages/platform/atoms/availability/AvailabilitySettings.tsx`
  - `packages/features/schedules/components/ScheduleListItem.tsx`
  - `apps/web/test/lib/availabilityAsString.test.ts`
- Callers of `AvailableTimesHeader`:
  - `apps/web/modules/bookings/components/AvailableTimeSlots.tsx`
  - `apps/web/modules/embed/components/Embed.tsx`
- Callers of `UserForm`:
  - `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-add-view.tsx`
  - `apps/web/modules/users/views/users-edit-view.tsx`
- Caller of `GeneralView`:
  - `apps/web/app/(use-page-wrapper)/settings/(settings-layout)/my-account/general/page.tsx`

I left out `apps/web/components/settings/TravelScheduleModal.tsx`. It imports only a type (`FormValues`) from `general-view.tsx`, so it doesn't call the function.

The signature itself would only break callers that pass different arguments. The second-level files are affected only if the change alters what the first-level functions return or accept.
